name: fail-then-retry
description: The summarizer rule matches the X-Fake-LLM-Caller header value summarizer and returns a short summary. It is listed first so it wins over the catch-all. Every other caller hits the catch-all: the first call returns HTTP 500 with an api_error body, and the next call returns a normal text reply.

respond.text: Summary: the week looks mild, and a pot of lentil soup takes about forty minutes.

error.body: {"type":"error","error":{"type":"api_error","message":"An internal error occurred. Please retry the request."}}

respond.text: Tomorrow looks mild and dry. A pot of lentil soup takes about forty minutes.
